g.text: UPDATE runs SET status = 'running', started_at = now(), heartbeat_at = now(), worker_id = $2

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM runs WHERE status = 'queued' AND worker_tag = ANY($1::text[])
